title: Vilca Craft
description: This is an Tech-Survival modpack, based on NeoForge
body:
# Vilca Craft


This tech-survival modpack offers a tougher, more technical take on Minecraft. You’ll progress through a structured tech ladder, unlock machines, set up power systems, and automate resource production step by step. Early-game survival is tighter, and efficient planning becomes essential.

The world features a variety of dungeons filled with enemies, loot, and progression rewards, giving you clear goals and extra challenges as you advance.

Hostile mobs are stronger, resources are more limited, and the environment is less forgiving than in vanilla Minecraft. If you enjoy tech progression, automation, exploration, and a more demanding survival experience, this modpack is built for you.
